name: TransientLifestyle
summary: A new instance is created for every consumer that asks for one, and none is ever reused.

reference.author: Steven van Deursen, Mark Seemann
reference.work: Dependency Injection Principles, Practices, and Patterns

roles.name: TransientLifestyle
roles.summary: A class of which a fresh instance is made on each request. It may hold state freely, because nothing of it survives the consumer that received it — and if it is disposable, that is the difficulty: the container generally will not track it, so a disposal nobody arranged is a leak nothing reports.
